The raised qualification names g as genre relatif, writes nu=card I and the pair condition (g,nu)≠(0,1). These are statements transcribed from the page.

Source assertion beginning Je dis: the page contains the eta-to-U and fundamental-group arrows, then the wording n’est pas trivial. The raised si nu≥2 clause is attached before que, and ell donné is inserted before the homology diagram. These are the author’s own qualifications and assertions; no proof check has been performed.

Source explanation, second paragraph: the author calls the section of J^1_{X/S} defined by f régulière, writes est nul for the stated composite, and describes an image in the partie torique. The final quotient retains the two visible Z-to-T revisions. No additional term, arrow, hat, or identification is supplied from H’s explanatory notes.
Source final note remains unfinished at the literal words "[NB cette partie est nulle si $\operatorname{card}I=1$, et"; no closing bracket or continuation is supplied.

Layout: one autograph text sheet, no autograph number at the head, one small bottom-left foliation 75 in another hand. The main prose has 22 baselines under the counting convention used here; short raised/lowered revisions and the diagram’s added lower nodes are excluded from that count, and the two stacked canceled clauses are recorded in one main-line-8 revision area.

The whole page, top native half and bottom native half were each viewed once. All agreed words, accents, punctuation, indices and signs were inspected directly. P01–P22 were each saved once at width 2800 using autocontrast, LANCZOS enlargement and mild sharpening; no crop was recreated. P03 was displayed successfully after an earlier tool response was truncated.

Graphical review only: the diagram has one horizontal rightward arrow, one northeast arrow and one upward arrow, with both lower nodes added. Its two similarity labels and all four objects were read locally. These observations are not mathematical check events.

The physical line-end hyphen and unaccented spelling in caracteris- are preserved with a line break before tique. No terminal point is added after the raised (0,1). The detached comma following the added S\setminus{s} expression is retained.

H’s editorial explanatory notes are not source text. Plain/mathcal rendering of the same J shape is not counted as a material alphabet change; H’s extra hat is separately rejected on its ink. Open-entry U observations are explicit in the hand log for the root’s consistent alphabet accounting.
No OCR, image-to-text service, external research, TeX compilation, another-page inspection or blind-pass reading was used.
